patterns.note: Product grid sections feature a large hero product card alongside smaller, equally sized product cards, creating a visual hierarchy and focal point within the grid.
The site uses a high-contrast black and white palette, allowing the vibrant, high-resolution product photography of the watches to be the primary source of color and visual interest.
The main header bar transforms from a transparent overlay on the hero to a solid black background with white text as the user scrolls down the page, while remaining sticky at the top.
The hero section utilizes a carousel system to display multiple high-resolution product images, indicated by navigation arrows and changing content between full-page views.
Alternating light and dark background sections (white content, black footer) provide clear visual separation and structure to the page content.

technique_notes: The site employs a sticky header that dynamically changes its background and text color upon scroll, transitioning from transparent over the hero to a solid black bar with white text for contrast against subsequent content. This effect can be achieved with JavaScript listening for scroll events to add/remove classes.

A full-width hero image carousel is used to showcase key products, allowing users to navigate between different high-quality visuals. This is typically built using a slider library like Swiper, enabling smooth transitions and navigation controls.

Content sections are structured with generous vertical padding, using a combination of full-width and grid layouts to present product information and calls to action. Product cards within grids maintain consistent sizing and minimal styling to emphasize the product imagery.

design_tokens.type_scale: Headings are set in a clean, uppercase sans-serif, typically 1.5x to 2.5x the size of the small, legible body text, with consistent letter spacing for an elegant and airy presentation.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners are dominant across most elements, with very subtle rounding on interactive elements like input fields and buttons.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced and airy, with ample vertical spacing between major sections and within the hero, while product grids maintain a consistent, slightly denser rhythm.

standout: The site's standout feature is its sophisticated, gallery-like presentation of high-end watches, achieved through immaculate, full-bleed product photography and a minimalist black-and-white design that allows the product to be the sole focal point. The design avoids common marketing clutter, opting for an editorial, almost museum-like display.
